adds.title: Agent Carter S1#5
adds.text: In 1946, Dugan and the Howling Commandos join Peggy's raid on a Leviathan complex, where a young girl stabs him and shoots Juniper dead.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Back with the Commandos for Peggy's Leviathan raid, where he is stabbed.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Dugan's unit, back together for Peggy's raid on Leviathan.
adds.evidence: The Iron Ceiling (Agent Carter S1 episode 5): Carter meets members of the 107th, Dugan, Sawyer, Juniper and Pinkerton, nicknamed the Howling Commandos; they infiltrate the complex together, a girl stabs Dugan and shoots Juniper, and Dugan blows a hole in the wall so the group can escape.
